MACs: must be unique per lab, start with 02: (locally administered), and match the static DHCP leases. If you omit a MAC, the renderer generates one deterministically from the plan name and node name. Provide explicit values when you need exact, reproducible identities.

Legacy flat MAC fields (mgmt_mac, storage_mac, etc.) are kept alongside the interfaces list for Ansible role compatibility during the transition to full inventory-driven provisioning. They must stay in sync with the interfaces entries.

docs.title: downstream_clusters
docs.text:
rancher and rancher-test profiles only. Each entry is a custom cluster that Rancher provisions on lab VMs during the downstream phase. Every node runs etcd, control plane and worker, so a 3-node cluster is a 3-member etcd HA.

downstream_clusters:
  - name: k3s-single
    distro: k3s            # k3s | rke2
    nodes: [k3s]
  - name: rke2-ha
    distro: rke2
    nodes: [rke2-ha1, rke2-ha2, rke2-ha3]
Field Notes name Cluster name in Rancher (fleet-default namespace) distro k3s or rke2; the Kubernetes version comes from versions.downstream_k3s / versions.downstream_rke2 in the plan nodes VM names from nodes; a VM can belong to one cluster only

The phase waits until every cluster is Ready with all its nodes, and a re-run skips nodes that are already registered.

docs.title: rancher.ui_extensions
docs.text:
Declares which Rancher Prime UI extensions (e.g. the SUSE Virtualization / Harvester extension) this rodeo needs, each pinned to a version. Only meaningful for profiles that have a Rancher VM: omit the key (or leave the list empty) for a Harvester-only profile with no Rancher, or a profile that doesn't need any extension.

On every deploy (and any time you run rodeo install-extensions)rodeo-cli reconciles each declared entry against the live cluster: it makes sure the chart repo (ClusterRepo) exists, force-reindexes it so the pinned version is resolvable even from a stale cached index, then installs the chart (or upgrades an older release in place) via the Rancher catalog API. Already-current extensions are left alone. Reconcile is non-fatal: a failed entry logs a warning and the deploy continues: it never blocks the rest of the pipeline over one bad chart pull.

definition:
  rancher:
    ui_extensions:
      - name: harvester              # chart name in the repo, and the UIPlugin name
        version: "1.8.1"             # keep in step with the Harvester server version
        repo:
          name: rancher              # ClusterRepo name (reused if it already exists)
          git_repo: https://github.com/rancher/ui-plugin-charts
          git_branch: main
Field Required Notes name yes Chart name in the repo. Also becomes the installed UIPlugin resource's name. version yes Pinned chart version. Reconcile upgrades/downgrades to match exactly. repo.name yes ClusterRepo name. Reused across entries that share a repo: declare it once. repo.git_repo only if the repo doesn't already exist Git URL for the chart repo. Skipped if repo.name already exists as a ClusterRepo (e.g. declared by an earlier entry, or pre-existing on the cluster). repo.git_branch no Defaults to main.

ui_extensions is a list: declare more than one entry to reconcile several extensions from the same or different repos.

Where this actually has to live: rodeo up --profile <name> and rodeo new --from <name> deploy from rodeo/data/examples/<name>/definition.yaml (the bundled example gets copied into your lab dir), not from rodeo/data/platforms/suse-virt/definition.yaml. If you're adding this to a bundled profile rather than a custom one, edit the example's own definition.yaml, or it will silently never take effect, see rodeo install-extensions for how to check and install after the fact.

docs.title: What belongs here vs. rodeo-plan.yaml
docs.text:
Put it in definition.yaml Put it in rodeo-plan.yaml Node names, IPs, MACs VM resource sizing (RAM, CPU, disk) Network CIDR, gateway, DNS domain Credentials and secret references Start order and etcd join gap Deployment target (baremetal/instruqt) Exposed services and port mapping Software versions Node templates (interface roles) Storage device path Host prep requirements Jinja2 parameters

The rule of thumb: the definition is what. The plan is how big and where.

docs.title: Generated vs. explicit values
docs.text:
The renderer (rodeo/inventory.py) can generate missing values deterministically:

Field How generated when omitted mac Hash of plan.name + node.name + role + index, stable across runs uuid UUID v5 from the same hash hostname Nice labels: alpha, bravo, charlie, … or <name>-N

Explicit values always win. Provide them when you need exact, stable identities, for example, when reprovisioning a node that other systems (DNS, monitoring) already know by its MAC.

docs.title: rodeo-plan.yaml reference
docs.text:
rodeo-plan.yaml is the resource and deployment configuration for a lab. It answers: how big are the VMs, where are they stored, what are the credentials, and what deployment target is this running on?

It does not describe topology (nodes, network, services). That lives in definition.yaml.

Both files together form a profile: the complete description of a lab that rodeo up, plan, and deploy consume.

docs.title: Full annotated example
docs.text:
# The pipeline this plan uses. Determines which phases run.
# suse-virt: Harvester HCI (with or without Rancher)
# rancher:   Rancher Prime on K3s only (no Harvester, no PXE)
type: suse-virt

# Used as the libvirt object prefix, state file name, and log label.
# Must be unique per host if you run multiple labs.
name: my-lab

# Where this lab runs. Controls whether the finalise phase is deferred,
# and (for aws) whether the laptop provisions an EC2 host then remote-deploys.
# baremetal: full deploy on this host, including VM autostart on host reboot
# remote:    deploy over SSH to the KVM host in remote_host: (phases run as baremetal there)
# instruqt:  skips finalise until you run `rodeo deploy --from finalise --finalise`
# aws:       laptop control plane: provision EC2, then remote `rodeo up --target baremetal`
deployment_target: baremetal

# Virtual machine resource allocation.
# These are the per-VM values. total host RAM = (harvester nodes × memory_mib) + rancher.memory_mib.
resources:
  harvester:
    memory_mib: 16384   # RAM per Harvester node in MiB (16 GiB)
    vcpu: 8             # vCPUs per Harvester node
    disk_gb: 320        # disk per Harvester node: do not go below ~250 (see note)

  rancher:
    memory_mib: 8192    # RAM for the Rancher VM in MiB (8 GiB)
    vcpu: 4             # vCPUs for Rancher
    disk_gb: 60         # disk for the Rancher VM

# Credentials. Values starting with ?? are resolved at deploy time: never hardcoded here.
#
# ?? resolution sources (in order of preference):
#   ??key            → ~/.rodeo/secrets.yaml key named "key"
#   ??env:VAR_NAME   → environment variable VAR_NAME
#   ??file:/path     → contents of a file
#   ??cmd:command    → stdout of a shell command (trimmed)
#
# Secrets resolve only in a trusted lab. rodeo trust approves the whole lab
# directory (a sha256 over every file in it except the state rodeo writes, such
# as .rodeo-secrets.yaml, content/ and logs); any change makes it untrusted
# again. Labs rodeo seeds into an empty directory from a bundled profile are
# trusted already; cloned, imported, catalog and hand-made labs need
# `rodeo trust` (or `rodeo trust --yes` in automation). Content repositories
# fetched by URL are trusted by URL and ref, not by commit. Write commands (deploy, up, clean, export, ...) resolve
# secrets; read commands (plan, status, logs, ...) never do. -P and --paramfile
# values may not contain ??, {{, {% or a newline, and may only set data keys:
# resources, versions, network, name, type, deployment_target, instance,
# libvirt.disk_cache/disk_io, rancher_tls.email, elemental.registrations,
# lab_in_a_box.variant/iso_image, provider.region/instance_type/ttl_hours,
# story.language/id, content.facts (each value checked), and the names in
# parameters: below (plain scalars that only feed the template). URL, ref,
# checksum and path keys, such as a plan-declared versions.<x>_url or
# versions.<x>_ref, can't be set through -P: change them in this file.
# content.facts take plain sentences or http(s) URLs: they only fill the
# rendered guide, never a shell. provider.ttl_hours must stay in (0, 168]. Under sudo the environment is
# not passed on, so ??key is the form that works there.
#
# rodeo up and rodeo init generate ~/.rodeo/secrets.yaml automatically.
# Deploy fails immediately if any ?? placeholder cannot be resolved.
credentials:
  harvester_os_password: "??harvester_os_password"     # OS login for Harvester nodes (rancher user)
  harvester_admin_password: "??harvester_admin_password" # Harvester web UI admin password
  rancher_admin_password: "??rancher_admin_password"   # Rancher web UI admin password
  harvester_token: "??harvester_token"                 # RKE2 cluster join token (internal)

# Network settings at the plan level. Most network config lives in definition.yaml.
# Override here only if your host uses a non-default VIP or gateway.
network:
  vip: 192.168.122.10     # Harvester cluster VIP (kube-vip floating IP)

# Storage configuration for the host.
storage:
  device: ""                          # "" = use the default single-disk path
                                      # "/dev/nvme1n1" = dedicate a second disk
  image_dir: /var/lib/libvirt/images  # where VM disks and ISOs are stored

# Software versions. Pin these to reproduce a specific lab.
versions:
  harvester: "1.8.2"          # Harvester ISO version to download and install
  rancher: "2.14.5"           # Rancher Prime Helm chart version
  k3s: "v1.35.3+k3s1"         # K3s version for the Rancher VM
  cert_manager: "v1.20.1"     # cert-manager Helm chart version (Rancher dependency)

# Jinja2 templating: define variables used in this file.
# Values can be overridden with -P or --paramfile at deploy time.
parameters:
  harvester_mem: 16384

# Then use them:
# resources:
#   harvester:
#     memory_mib: {{ harvester_mem }}

docs.title: type
docs.text:
Value Pipeline Phases suse-virt Harvester HCI (with or without Rancher) kvm_host → vms → pxe_server → cluster → rancher → apply → finalise → custom_scripts rancher, rancher-test Rancher Prime on K3s + the K3s/RKE2 clusters it provisions kvm_host → vms → boot → rancher → downstream → apply → finalise → custom_scripts suse-edge SUSE Edge 3.7 (Rancher + Elemental + EIB + edge nodes) kvm_host → vms → boot → rancher → elemental → apply → finalise → custom_scripts lab-in-a-box External plugin: the lab-in-a-box engine builds the lab its own phases (see the plugin's docs)

Required. No default.

docs.title: name
docs.text:
String. Used as the prefix for all libvirt objects (<name>-harvester1, etc.), the state file name (~/.rodeo/state/<name>.yaml), and log labels.

Must be unique per host. Changing name after deploy creates orphaned resources, run rodeo clean first.

docs.title: deployment_target
docs.text:
Value Behaviour baremetal Full deploy on the host rodeo runs on (this machine). finalise enables VM autostart on host reboot. instruqt finalise is skipped automatically. Run it after the Instruqt snapshot: rodeo deploy --from finalise --finalise aws Laptop control plane: require a provider: block, provision/reuse one EC2 KVM host, wait for SSH, remote-run rodeo up on that host. Tear down with rodeo destroy --cloud --yes. BYO: create the instance yourself, keep deployment_target: aws (or set storage.backend: nvme) and deploy on the box. gcp Same as aws on Google Cloud: provision/reuse one Compute Engine VM with nested virtualization, wait for SSH, remote-run rodeo up on it. Tear down with rodeo destroy --cloud --yes. See provider (gcp).

| remote | Control plane: deploy to a KVM host you already own. Requires a remote_host: block, ships the lab's plan files over SSH and runs rodeo up --target baremetal on the host. Nothing is provisioned and rodeo destroy --cloud does not apply: the host is yours. |

Required. Defaults to baremetal when omitted. Plugins can add targets via host_context.register_host_context() (see the architecture doc's extension points): a registered target is accepted here, by --target, and by the rodeo up prompt.

On instruqt, rodeo up / lab seeding also applies host-aware resources presets so Σ guest vCPU stays near ~70% of the builder (Harvester typically 6–8 vCPU / 20 GiB). Existing plans are not rewritten on re-deploy; only seeded plans get the presets. rodeo doctor / rodeo deploy --check warn (non-fatal) when a plan still exceeds the budget.

docs.title: remote_host
docs.text:
Required by deployment_target: remote, ignored by every other target. The host is yours: rodeo neither creates nor destroys it, and only needs to reach it.

deployment_target: remote
remote_host:
  host: kvm-01.lab.example        # name or IP (required)
  ssh_user: root                  # login; default root
  identity_file: ~/.ssh/id_ed25519  # private key; default rodeo's managed key
  lab_dir: /root/rodeo-lab        # where the lab lands on the host

rodeo up --yes --profile harvester --target remote

The control plane ships rodeo-plan.yaml, definition.yaml and the effective secrets over SSH, installs or updates rodeo on the host (--ref pins the version it runs), then runs rodeo up --target baremetal there, streaming its output back. The host needs: SSH as ssh_user with that key, passwordless sudo for that user, and a distribution that can host labs (the same requirement as a local baremetal deploy). Its log stays on the host at ~/.rodeo/logs/remote-up.log.

The private key itself is never shipped: only the control plane reads it. In the builder, a stored KVM host (SSH) credential fills this block in, and writes the key into the lab directory as .rodeo-remote-key (mode 600).

--detach returns once the host has started the deploy, printing one JSON line (pid, log, host); rodeo status --cloud then reports that run and the tail of its log. Each target keeps its own files on the host (remote-up.log, .pid, .exit beside the aws ones), so a deploy to a KVM host and one to an EC2 host never read or claim each other's state. A second rodeo up while one runs there exits 75 rather than racing it.

On aws, apply_host_context() (seed + deploy) raises resources.harvester.disk_gb to a flat 500 GB per Harvester node and resources.rancher.disk_gb to 60 GB (never scaled by node count: the rest of the NVMe device is deliberately left free, matching real-world/Instruqt sizing). Also sets storage.backend: nvme and mounts the largest non-root NVMe on image_dir. Nested virt is enabled by default on non-metal types.

Option A: one topology profile, AWS is where. Use the base profile and --target aws (there is no separate *-aws plan template):

rodeo up --yes --profile harvester --target aws --instance-tier recommended

Instance size comes from rodeo/providers/instance_catalog.py keyed by that same profile name. recommended for harvester and harvester-2n is m8id.8xlarge (32 vCPU / 128 GiB / a single ~1.9 TiB NVMe device, unlike i7i.8xlarge, which splits its NVMe across two devices and rodeo only mounts one). suse-edge recommended is m8id.4xlarge. Explicit provider.instance_type still wins.

Keep deployment_target: aws in the plan on the instance (host-context + destroy --cloud marker). On the EC2 box itself, phases run as baremetal. Never set lab.target: aws in Fleet workshop.yaml, use lab.target: baremetal there (see Fleet).

docs.title: provider (when deployment_target: aws)
docs.text:
Same shape as Fleet workshop.yaml provider. AWS needs type, region, subnet_id, and either instance_type or instance_tier.

The block is optional for rodeo up --target aws. Any profile deploys with rodeo up --profile <name> --target aws and no provider: at all. Whatever is missing is filled in and written back to rodeo-plan.yaml, so re-runs and rodeo destroy --cloud use the same values:

Field Default type aws region $RODEO_AWS_REGION, else eu-north-1 (not the AWS CLI's configured region: an account guardrail can leave that one without internet egress) subnet_id the region's default VPC, first public default-for-AZ subnet in an AZ that offers the instance type instance_type the profile's recommended tier (see below) ttl_hours 6: the dead-man switch (see below)

A region with no default VPC fails with a message naming the fields to set.

Every cloud host has a dead-man switch. Each instance rodeo creates (single host, fleet hosts, portal VM) expires provider.ttl_hours after launch, 6 hours by default. At that time a systemd timer in the guest powers it off, and because the instance is created with InstanceInitiatedShutdownBehavior: terminate, AWS terminates it rather than leaving a stopped instance that still bills for its disks. The timer runs at an absolute UTC time with Persistent=true, so a host stopped past its expiry powers off again as soon as it boots. The expiry is on the instance tag rodeo-expires-at, in /etc/rodeo-expires-at on the host, and in the output of rodeo up --target aws and rodeo fleet provision.

The switch cannot be turned off, except for kvm-hosts labs deployed with rodeo fleet (ttl_hours: off). For a longer workshop set provider.ttl_hours (more than 0, at most 168) before the hosts are created; re-running up or fleet provision on an existing host keeps its original expiry.

Security group is auto-managed unless you pin one. Omit security_group_ids and rodeo creates (or reuses) an SG named rodeo-<name> in the subnet's VPC, opens exactly the ports the host needs, SSH (22), Harvester UI (8443), Rancher NodePort (30002): and scopes all three to this machine's current public IP, detected automatically. Re-running from a different IP (new wifi, VPN toggled) updates the rule in place rather than piling up stale ones. rodeo destroy --cloud --yes deletes it once nothing else tagged for the workshop is still running (best-effort: if the instance hasn't finished detaching yet, re-run destroy: it's never left as a hard failure). Set security_group_ids explicitly to opt back into a hand-managed SG: useful for a shared multi-attendee IP range, a bastion topology, or an SG your org's security policy already owns.

Instance size (single-host v1): pick one of three tiers for the lab profile, or set an explicit type. rodeo up --target aws prompts interactively when neither is set; with --yes it uses recommended.

Tier Meaning budget Meets the profile minimum (often EBS-backed Nitro) recommended Preferred size for that profile (often local NVMe; see instance_catalog) performance Metal / larger escape hatch

Before create, rodeo checks the type is offered in the region and probes capacity via RunInstances DryRun. If the region has no capacity, it fails with a message to try another region or tier: it does not silently downsize.

deployment_target: aws
provider:
  type: aws
  region: eu-central-1
  # Either:
  instance_tier: recommended          # budget | recommended | performance
  # Or pin explicitly:
  # instance_type: m8id.8xlarge
  # ttl_hours: 6                      # dead-man switch, default 6, at most 168
  # ami omitted → newest suse-sles-16-0-v<date>-hvm-ssd-x86_64 (SLES 16 PAYG)
  # ami: ami-…                        # optional pin
  # ami_name_filter: "suse-sles-16-0-v????????-hvm-ssd-x86_64"
  subnet_id: subnet-…
  # security_group_ids: [sg-…]        # omit → rodeo creates/manages one,
  #                                    # scoped to this machine's public IP
  ssh_user: ec2-user                  # SLES 16 / Leap default
  # nested_virtualization: true       # default on for non-metal
  # volume_size_gib: 100              # root EBS; lab disks use NVMe
  # ref: main                         # rodeo-cli git ref to run on the host
  # install_url: https://…/install.sh # fork or air-gapped mirror

rodeo up --yes --profile harvester --target aws --instance-tier recommended

Which rodeo-cli the host runs (--ref / provider.ref). The instance bootstraps itself with install.sh from GitHub, your local working tree never reaches it. By default the bootstrap runs only when rodeo is absent, so a host stays on the code it was first installed with, the same way clean --refresh refuses to move a pinned host's version unasked.

Pass a ref to change that:

rodeo up --target aws --ref main         # pick up commits pushed since bootstrap
rodeo up --target aws --ref v0.15.0      # pin a release
rodeo up --target aws --ref feat/my-fix  # test a branch on a real host

A ref makes the bootstrap run every time and hard-resets the host's checkout to it (install.sh --ref), which is the only way a just-pushed commit reaches an existing host. The installer itself is fetched from the same ref, so install.sh and the code it installs cannot disagree. An explicit provider.install_url is used verbatim: for a fork or an air-gapped mirror, and the ref is still passed to it. --ref beats provider.ref; an invalid ref is rejected before any instance is launched, so a typo costs nothing. --ref applies only when the laptop is the AWS control plane; anywhere else it warns and is ignored.

To test a fork without editing plans, set environment variables where rodeo runs:

Variable Effect RODEO_REPO git URL install.sh clones and updates from; passed on to remote bootstraps. A GitHub URL also points the default install URL at that repository's install.sh RODEO_INSTALL_URL_TEMPLATE install.sh URL with a {ref} placeholder, for non-GitHub mirrors

A configured install_url still wins over both. Fleet has the same mechanism, fleet deploy --ref / lab.ref.

AWS API credentials (boto3: never in the plan): ~/.aws/credentials / AWS_PROFILE, or AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID + AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY (+ optional AWS_SESSION_TOKEN). AWS CLI is optional. rodeo up checks them (sts get-caller-identity) before it provisions anything and stops when they are missing or expired.

AMI choice matters more than it looks. The default is SLES 16 pay-as-you-go (published by SUSE via Amazon), and it is not interchangeable with the alternatives:

  • openSUSE Leap 16 is a Marketplace product whose listing does not permit 7th-generation Intel instance types. Nested virtualisation needs exactly those, so Leap cannot run a nested lab on anything but *.metal.
  • SLES BYOS images allow i7i, but ship without a subscription, so zypper has no repos and install-deps fails. rodeo does not register hosts.

PAYG avoids both traps at a licence surcharge of roughly $0.125/hr on i7i.8xlarge. No Marketplace subscription or opt-in is needed.

SSH / root: new instances get cloud-init UserData that installs the managed pubkey for root and passwordless sudo for ssh_user (ec2-user on SLES 16). Remote rodeo up runs under sudo -n so it never prompts. rodeo ssh primary or rodeo ssh primary/rancher use the same managed key.

docs.title: provider (when deployment_target: gcp)
docs.text:
The block is optional for rodeo up --target gcp. Log in once with gcloud auth application-default login, then any profile deploys with rodeo up --profile <name> --target gcp. Missing fields are filled in and written back to rodeo-plan.yaml:

Field Default type gcp project $RODEO_GCP_PROJECT / $GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT, else the application default credentials' quota project, else gcloud config get-value project region $RODEO_GCP_REGION, else europe-west4 (the only EU region with every tier) zone first zone of the region that offers the machine type; the next one when a zone has no capacity instance_type the profile's recommended tier (see the table below) image latest sles-16-1-x86-64 from suse-cloud (SLES 16.1 pay-as-you-go). image_family / image_project pick another family ssh_user rodeo (created by the guest agent from the lab key in ssh-keys metadata, with passwordless sudo) network / subnetwork rodeo-<region> for both, created on first use (10.90.0.0/20). Set them to use your own VPC allowed_cidrs this machine's public IP (/32) boot_disk_gb 100 on -lssd shapes; on shapes without local SSD, the plan's guest disks plus 60 service_account default (the project's compute service account) with only the userinfo.email scope ttl_hours 6: the dead-man switch

What rodeo creates, all labelled managed-by=rodeo and rodeo-workshop=<lab>:

  • The VM, with enableNestedVirtualization. Only Intel series run nested KVM on GCE (C4, N4, N2, C3, Z3); AMD, Arm and E2 shapes are refused.
  • A firewall rule rodeo-<lab> for ports 22, 8443 and 30002 from allowed_cidrs, re-scoped when your IP changes, deleted with the last instance.
  • The dead-man switch is native: scheduling.maxRunDuration with instanceTerminationAction: DELETE. Google deletes the VM and its disks at expiry, even if your laptop is off.
  • A service account on the VM. SLES pay-as-you-go registers its repositories with the VM's identity token. Without a service account there is no token and zypper has no repositories.

Machine types per tier (bare metal is left out for now: it starts at 192 vCPU and about $9/h):

Tier Series Example budget N4 + Hyperdisk Balanced (no local SSD, the pool sits on the boot disk) n4-standard-16 recommended C4 -lssd (local NVMe) c4-standard-16-lssd, c4-standard-32-lssd for Harvester performance a bigger or high-memory C4 -lssd c4-highmem-32-lssd

Local SSD comes as 375 GiB NVMe disks, several of them on shapes above 8 vCPU (c4-standard-32-lssd has 5). The kvm_host phase stripes them into one RAID0 pool for image_dir. The data is gone when the VM stops, like an AWS instance store.

docs.title: resources
docs.text:
Per-VM sizing. All fields are per-node (not total).

Field Unit Minimum Notes memory_mib MiB 12288 (12 GiB) for Harvester Harvester requires at least 12 GiB; 16 GiB recommended vcpu threads 4 On hyper-threaded hosts, each thread counts disk_gb GiB 320 for Harvester Elemental's persistent partition is a fixed 150 GiB floor regardless of disk size; below ~250 it starves and containerd fails; the rest goes to Longhorn's own partition, so bigger leaves Longhorn more room

The rancher block is only used when the topology includes a Rancher VM (see definition.yaml).

docs.title: credentials
docs.text:
All credential values must use ?? placeholders. Plain text passwords in plan files are rejected by validate_config().

Key Used for harvester_os_password OS login on Harvester nodes (rancher user SSH + console) harvester_admin_password admin user in the Harvester web UI rancher_admin_password admin user in the Rancher web UI harvester_token RKE2 cluster join token: internal; do not share with attendees

rodeo up and rodeo init generate random values and write them to ~/.rodeo/secrets.yaml (chmod 600). Never commit that file.

docs.title: network
docs.text:
Field Default Notes vip 192.168.122.10 Harvester cluster VIP. Must be in the same /24 as nodes but outside the DHCP range.

Most network topology (CIDR, gateway, DNS domain, per-node IPs) is in definition.yaml.

docs.title: storage
docs.text: Field Default Notes device "" Leave empty for single-disk hosts. Set to /dev/nvme1n1 (or similar) to dedicate a second disk. Confirm with lsblk. image_dir /var/lib/libvirt/images Where libvirt stores VM disks and ISOs. Must have 600–900 GiB free for a full lab.

docs.title: libvirt
docs.text:
Field Default Notes uri qemu:///system libvirt connection URI: qemu:///system, qemu:///session or qemu+ssh/qemu+tls/qemu+tcp to [user@]host[:port] (a bracketed IPv6 literal works) and /system or /session. No query string: ?keyfile=, ?known_hosts=, ?no_verify= and the like are refused (some run a command); put SSH options in ~/.ssh/config instead. disk_cache target-dependent Guest qcow2 cache= mode. Default none on baremetal, writeback when deployment_target: instruqt (better nested cloud I/O). Allowed: none, writethrough, writeback, unsafe, directsync. disk_io target-dependent Guest qcow2 io= mode. Default native on baremetal, threads on Instruqt. Allowed: native, threads, io_uring.

Override at deploy time without editing the plan:

rodeo deploy -P libvirt.disk_cache=writeback -P libvirt.disk_io=threads

docs.title: versions
docs.text:
Defaults depend on the engine type:

Field suse-virt rancher / rancher-test suse-edge Notes harvester "1.8.2" Harvester ISO; rodeo refuses a version without a pinned sha512 (set versions.harvester_iso_checksum: sha512:<digest>). rancher "2.14.5" "2.15.2" "2.15.1" Rancher Prime Helm chart. k3s "v1.35.3+k3s1" "v1.36.4+k3s1" "v1.36.3+k3s1" K3s on the Rancher VM. cert_manager "v1.20.1" "v1.21.2" "v1.20.1" cert-manager Helm chart. downstream_k3s "v1.36.4+k3s1" Kubernetes version of the K3s clusters Rancher provisions. downstream_rke2 "v1.36.4+rke2r1" Kubernetes version of the RKE2 clusters Rancher provisions. elemental_operator, elemental_operator_crds "1.9.2" Elemental Operator charts. elemental_ui_extension "3.0.3" Elemental UI extension in Rancher. eib "1.3.4" Edge Image Builder container.

downstream_k3s / downstream_rke2 must be a version the Rancher release supports (Rancher 2.15.2: up to v1.36).

docs.title: parameters
docs.text: Optional map of Jinja2 template variables. Use to avoid repeating values across the file. Override at deploy time with -P key=value or --paramfile overrides.yaml.

docs.title: CLI overrides
docs.text:
You can override any plan value at deploy time without editing the file:

# Single value
rodeo deploy -P resources.harvester.memory_mib=20480

# Multiple values
rodeo deploy -P resources.harvester.vcpu=10 -P versions.harvester=1.5.0

# From a file (deep-merged over the plan)
rodeo deploy --paramfile big-lab.yaml

Precedence (lowest to highest): profile defaults → rodeo-plan.yaml → --paramfile → -P

docs.title: story: workshop narrative, languages, and variants
docs.text:
rodeo story render produces the participant hand-out for this lab from rmstory-tagged markdown in the lab's story/ directory:

<lab>/story/*.md       tagged markdown sources (authored in English)
<lab>/story/stories/   story-variant indexes, one <id>.yaml per variant
<lab>/story/strings/   translation store (rmstory filesystem backend)

The optional story: block sets the defaults (CLI flags override):

story:
  language: es          # target language (default en = source, no translation)
  id: villain-arc       # story variant to assemble (default: all spans)
  engine: gemini        # rmstory engine to machine-fill missing translations
  engine_env:           # engine credentials: ?? secrets are resolved
    GEMINI_API_KEY: "??gemini_api_key"

Deployment facts are substituted into the rendered text as Jinja expressions, write them inside invariant spans so translation never touches them: <span no>{{ rancher_url }}</span>. Available facts: name, type, language, vip, harvester_url, rancher_ip, rancher_url, rancher_nodeport, dns_domain, gateway, vms, vm_names, credentials.

Rendering in the source language with no variant needs nothing installed; translation and variant assembly use the rmstory system package (sudo rodeo install-deps --story: distro packages, never PyPI).

The post-deploy success screen uses the same machinery: each profile ships a tagged success.md, a lab can override it with story/success.md, and story.language localizes it. Translation problems always degrade to the English source: the payoff screen never fails.

docs.title: content: the lab's instructions, apart from its infrastructure
docs.text:
A plan can name where its instructions live instead of carrying them in the profile. The environment (rodeo up) and the instructions (rodeo content apply) then deploy separately: updating the instructions never redeploys the lab.

content:
  repo: https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>   # https, public, no credentials
  ref: main             # branch, tag or commit (default: the default branch)
  path: story           # directory in the repository (default: the root)
  format: rmstory       # rmstory | instruqt | markdown
  facts:                # instruqt: values for [[ Instruqt-Var key="..." ]]
    SMLM_URL: https://smlm.rodeo.lab
  replace:              # literal text swaps when rendering
    "smlm.example.com": smlm.rodeo.lab

rodeo content apply (run from the lab directory) fetches the content into <lab>/content/, records the commit in <lab>/content.lock and renders the guide into <lab>/guide/ (owner-only files: facts can hold lab passwords):

Language branches. A content repository keeps its source language on the default branch and each translation in a branch named after its language (es, pt-br...). Without a ref, a plan whose story.language isn't the source language (en) takes the branch named after that language. When the repository has no such branch, the instructions come from the default branch and rodeo warns. With either the language branch or ref: set to it, rodeo also warns when that branch is behind the default branch: the default branch has commits the language branch hasn't taken in. Changes under rmstory/, rmstory-stories/, story/ and .github/ don't count. A catalog rodeo (rodeo new <name> --from <repo>@<lang>, or a catalog ref:) gets the same warning when that ref is its plan's story.language.

rodeo story check [DIR] runs that check on a clone of the content repository. For each language branch it lists the commits the branch misses, and it exits 1 when a branch is behind, so it can gate CI (check out the full history, e.g. fetch-depth: 0). With no --language, it checks every branch named like a two-letter language tag. --source names the source branch when it isn't the clone's default.

format read from <path> guide rmstory *.md, chapters.yaml, stories/, strings/ guide.md, rendered like rodeo story render instruqt <challenge>/assignment.md one <challenge>.md each, facts and replace applied markdown *.md one file each, replace applied

At the repository's root, whatever path names, the content can also carry the profile layout's checks/ and custom/scripts/:

  • checks/ is installed into /opt/rodeo/<plan name>/checks/, root-owned and readable and runnable by every user on the host (a student's account included), replacing the previous copy. Installing needs root; without it the guide is still rendered and the command says how to rerun. rodeo clean removes it (rodeo clean --all: every plan's).
  • custom/scripts/ holds setup scripts: the executable ones run in sorted order on the host, from that directory, with the environment the profile's own custom/scripts/ get (KUBECONFIG, RODEO_PLAN_NAME, RODEO_CONFIG_DIR, RODEO_LAB_DIR) plus RODEO_CONTENT_DIR, the fetched repository. They run on every apply, so write them to be idempotent. Each prints its output; a failing one doesn't stop the others, and rodeo content apply then exits 1.

The scripts run as the user running rodeo (root under rodeo up), from whatever ref points at: pin a tag or commit when the repository isn't yours.

rodeo up applies it after a successful deploy, after the profile's own custom/scripts/; a failure there only warns. A content script named like one of the profile's own custom/scripts/ is left out there, since the profile's copy already ran. On deployment_target: instruqt, rodeo up leaves the setup scripts out for the engines that leave out their profile's custom scripts (they belong in the baked image); rodeo content apply runs them. rodeo content show prints the block, the last fetched commit, the setup scripts and where the checks are installed. An rmstory content is also what rodeo story render reads when the lab has no story/ of its own. The workshop: block (Instruqt tracks for lab-in-a-box labs) and an in-profile story/ keep working as before.

docs.title: lab_in_a_box: deploying with, or exporting to, lab-in-a-box
docs.text:
lab-in-a-box builds VMs and runs addons (SUSE Multi-Linux Manager, Uyuni, NeuVector, ...) from a lab.json. rodeo renders that file from the plan and definition, which stay the source of truth, in two ways:

  • type: lab-in-a-box deploys through it. rodeo prepares the host (packages, libvirt network and DNS, firewall forwards for exposed_services, base images, secrets), installs lab-in-a-box (its latest release unless source.ref says otherwise), and runs its setup_lab.py. The phases are kvm_host, labinabox_host, labinabox and custom_scripts. rodeo clean runs its destroy_lab.py.
  • rodeo export --format lab-in-a-box only writes the lab.json, for a lab-in-a-box automation node you run yourself.

The lab_in_a_box: block holds the knobs that exist only on the lab-in-a-box side:

lab_in_a_box:
  source:                               # type: lab-in-a-box only, which lab-in-a-box to run
    repo: https://github.com/SUSE-Technical-Marketing/lab-in-a-box
    ref: latest                         # latest (highest version tag, default), tag, branch or SHA
  parallel: 4                           # setup_lab.py --parallel=N
  root_password: "??universal_pwd"      # root password of every VM
  images:                               # base images: become SOURCE_IMAGE/SOURCE_SHA256 in lab.json;
                                        # lab-in-a-box downloads + verifies them into ISO_LOC
    - name: ubuntu-24.04-server-cloudimg-amd64.img
      url: https://cloud-images.ubuntu.com/releases/24.04/release/ubuntu-24.04-server-cloudimg-amd64.img
      sha256_url: https://cloud-images.ubuntu.com/releases/24.04/release/SHA256SUMS   # or sha256: <hex>
  nodes:                                # per-node lab.json keys, by short node name
    ubuntu2404lts: {SOURCE_IMAGE: ubuntu-24.04-server-cloudimg-amd64.img, ssh_pwauth: "true"}
    smlm: {SOURCE_IMAGE: smlm.qcow2, addons: [smlm]}
  iso_image: openSUSE-Leap-15.6.qcow2   # common base image for nodes without their own
  config_method: cloud-init             # cloud-init (default) | virt_customize | "" (ignition/combustion)
  cluster_name: mgmt                    # kcluster name (also its DNS record: <name>.<domain>)
  cluster_type: k3s                     # k3s (default) | rke2
  clu_rel: stable                       # install channel, exact version pins don't carry over
  addons: [rancher]                     # override the derived kcluster install_<addon> list
  sections:                             # verbatim lab.json sections (addon config)
    smlm: {smlm_deployment: podman, smlm_admin_pass: "??smlm_admin_password"}

The lab itself: lab_in_a_box.lab can instead hold a whole lab-in-a-box lab (common, nodes keyed by FQDN, kclusters, one section per add-on), as the lab-in-a-box lab-builder edits it. rodeo deploys it as written and sets only what belongs to the host: the common network keys and lab_name, each node's BRIDGE, myip, mymac and FQDN domain, the kclusters' mydomain, images (SOURCE_IMAGE) and secrets. The lab's nodes are the lab's VMs: one that definition.yaml lists keeps that address, any other gets its myip host part in the lab's network when free (else the next free address); definition nodes the lab leaves out are not deployed. nodes and sections above, and a variant's, are merged into it. Reference VMs from add-on sections as ${node_fqdn:<vm>} / ${node_ip:<vm>}. smlm-workshop carries its lab this way. rodeo new <name> --from-lab-json <file> writes such a plan from an existing lab (see Create your own rodeo).

lab_in_a_box:
  lab:
    common: {config_method: cloud-init}
    nodes:
      smlm.rodeo.lab: {myip: "192.168.122.20", VM_MEM: "16384", VM_CPU: "8", VM_DSK: "300",
                       SOURCE_IMAGE: smlm.qcow2, addons: [smlm]}
    smlm: {smlm_deployment: podman, smlm_admin_pass: "??smlm_admin_password"}

Variants: lab_in_a_box.variants.<name> overlays the block, and lab_in_a_box.variant picks one (-P lab_in_a_box.variant=<name>). In an overlay, dicts merge, null deletes a key, and images merge by name (remove: true drops one). A variant can add operator_secrets and a notice logged at deploy. Only the selected variant's secrets are asked for. smlm-workshop uses this to switch between booting its pre-built server (image) and building it from stock SLES (scratch).

An image's url can also be a list of mirrors, tried in order and all checked against the same checksum.

Secrets: every credential is a ??key. rodeo up generates any plain ??key the plan references that ~/.rodeo/secrets.yaml lacks. Keys listed under a top-level operator_secrets: are the exception: those are values only you have, such as an SCC regcode or a pre-built image's password, and rodeo up asks for them instead (under --yes it stops and says which ones to add). The rendered lab.json holds the resolved values, so it is written 0600 to <lab>/.labinabox/. The deploy stops if any ?? value is still unresolved.

To test another lab-in-a-box without editing the plan, set RODEO_LABINABOX_REPO and/or RODEO_LABINABOX_REF; each takes precedence over the matching source: key. For a local lab-in-a-box checkout, set RODEO_LABINABOX_PATH=/path/to/lab-in-a-box; it takes precedence over all of them. These variables are read on the host that runs rodeo up. A rerun reinstalls lab-in-a-box when its source changes: another repo or ref, or for a local checkout a new commit or uncommitted edits.

Existing lab-in-a-box host: by default (target.mode: auto) rodeo installs lab-in-a-box on the host it runs on. It uses an existing one instead when that host already has lab-in-a-box set up (a /etc/lab_creation.cfg rodeo didn't write), or when target.host names a remote automation node:

lab_in_a_box:
  target:
    mode: auto            # auto | managed | existing
    host: automation.example.lab   # remote lab-in-a-box host (rodeo's key in its authorized_keys)
    ssh_user: root
    libvirt_uri: qemu+ssh://root@kvm1.example.lab/system   # its hypervisor, for status/start/stop

With an existing lab-in-a-box, rodeo skips kvm_host and leaves that host's install, network, firewall and keys alone. The lab has to fit that host's own network: set network.bridge/cidr/gateway/domain in definition.yaml, and anything else under sections.common (e.g. mydns).

A remote host gets lab.json over SSH stdin into ~/.rodeo-labs/<plan>/ (mode 0600, with an owner marker). setup_lab.py runs there and its output streams back. rodeo clean runs destroy_lab.py there, but only for a lab carrying this plan's marker. rodeo ssh <vm> hops through the host.

Every deploy, in either mode, first checks lab.json against the installed lab-in-a-box's own schema (lab_schema) and stops, naming the fields, if that lab-in-a-box is too old for the plan.

VMs in a cloud account instead of nested KVM: with lab_in_a_box.cloud, lab-in-a-box creates every node in a cloud account through its own compute backends: aws, gcp, hetzner, alibaba, scaleway, upcloud, ovhcloud, exoscale. The rodeo host then only runs lab-in-a-box, so it needs no KVM (a laptop or a small VM will do):

lab_in_a_box:
  iso_image: ami-0123456789abcdef0      # a provider image (AMI, image name/ID), per region
  cloud:
    cloudtype: aws
    account: aws-lab                    # credential file name, one per lab (clean removes it)
    settings:                           # the backend's keys, as in lab-in-a-box's README
      AWS_REGION: eu-north-1
      AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID: "??aws_access_key_id"
      AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: "??aws_secret_access_key"
  nodes:
    vm1: {cloud_instance_type: t3.large}

With an AWS SSO login, use the profile instead of keys: AWS_PROFILE: <profile> (the profile of the user that runs rodeo; a profile wins over keys). Temporary keys need AWS_SESSION_TOKEN too.

For cloudtype: aws, lab-in-a-box drives the aws CLI: sudo rodeo install-deps --aws installs the AWS CLI v2 from AWS (the installer's PGP signature is checked against AWS's key first), and rodeo up offers to do it when the CLI is missing. Preflight then asks AWS who the plan's credentials belong to and stops the deploy when there are none, or they are expired or rejected (e.g. "run aws sso login --profile <profile>").

rodeo writes the account to /etc/lab_creation/credentials/<account>.yaml (0600). Any ??key in settings is always asked for, never generated. Nodes get no static IP/MAC: the provider assigns them. rodeo reads the addresses back after the deploy, so rodeo ssh <vm> and the success screen use them.

Leave out settings to use an account that already exists on the lab-in-a-box host, e.g. an encrypted one made with setup_credentials.py.

rodeo status/start/stop/restart ask lab-in-a-box's vm_power.py, on every provider.

exposed_services become each target VM's open_ports. lab-in-a-box opens them with the provider's own mechanism:

Provider How the port is opened aws security-group rules (needs AWS_SECURITY_GROUP_ID) gcp a firewall rule plus a network tag on the VM alibaba rules on ALIBABA_SECURITY_GROUP_ID exoscale a per-VM security group hetzner, scaleway, upcloud, ovhcloud nothing to open: they let inbound traffic in by default, unless you added your own firewall

Several instances on one host: a top-level instance: N (1–99; 0 is the plan as written) moves a lab-in-a-box lab out of the way of other copies:

instance 0 instance N libvirt network / bridge default / virbr0 rodeo-iN / rbrN subnet, node IPs as defined third octet + N DNS domain as defined iN.<domain> MACs as defined third byte = N exposed host ports as defined + N × instance_port_stride (1000)

Generated passwords go to the lab's own .rodeo-secrets.yaml, so every instance gets its own; operator secrets stay in ~/.rodeo/secrets.yaml. rodeo instances new <profile> --count N seeds numbered labs, rodeo instances up deploys them one after another, rodeo instances list shows them (plus how many more fit in this host's free RAM and disk), and rodeo instances clean removes them.

In addon sections, ${node_fqdn:<vm>} and ${node_ip:<vm>} stand for that lab's own node. lab_in_a_box.dns_aliases: {<vm>: [name, ...]} adds names a node answers to inside its instance's network, e.g. the fixed name a pre-built server image was installed with.

Workshop tracks: a top-level workshop: block fetches an Instruqt track into <lab>/workshop at deploy time. It then warns about track machines with no lab VM and about assignment variables with no value:

workshop:
  repo: https://github.com/SUSE-Technical-Marketing/instruqt-SMLM
  branch: main
  track: smlms
  skip_vms: [zbastion]                  # machines the lab replaces on purpose
  facts: {SMLM_USERNAME: myadmin}       # [[ Instruqt-Var ]] values, shown on the success screen

Not carried over by rodeo export (warned at export time): PXE-booted Harvester nodes (lab-in-a-box has no PXE: use --skip-unsupported to export the rest), exposed-service host port-forwards, storage/image-dir selection, and exact k3s/rke2 version pins.

docs.title: What belongs here vs. definition.yaml
docs.text:
Put it in rodeo-plan.yaml Put it in definition.yaml VM resource sizing (RAM, CPU, disk) Node names, IPs, MACs Credentials and secret references Network CIDR, gateway, DNS domain Deployment target (baremetal/instruqt/aws) Start order and etcd join gap Software versions Exposed services and port mapping Storage device path Node templates (interface roles) Jinja2 parameters Host prep requirements (sysctls, SELinux)

The rule of thumb: the plan is how big and where. The definition is what.

docs.title: rodeo-cli
docs.text: // 宣告式 lab 部署 12 內建 profile 1,800+ 項測試 1 個指令完成部署 GPL-3.0 授權

docs.title: 不用寫 Ansible、不用碰 libvirt，就能建出真正的 lab 環境
docs.text:
rodeo-cli 是一套宣告式 CLI，把一個 YAML 檔變成 KVM 上可以實際操作的 lab：SUSE Virtualization（Harvester）、Rancher Prime、SUSE Edge、SUSE Telco Cloud，或單純的 KVM 主機。profile 就是 lab，要在哪裡執行則另外決定：SLES 16 主機、Instruqt builder、AWS、Google Cloud，或你已經有的 KVM 主機。

開始使用 → 前往 GitHub

docs.title: 為什麼要做這個工具
docs.text:
為了 demo、workshop 或測試建一套 Harvester 叢集或 Rancher Prime，通常得寫 Ansible、手動接 libvirt 網路，而且每次都要重新摸一遍同樣的 iPXE 開機流程。rodeo-cli 用一個概念取代這一切：描述你要的 lab，交給 plan/apply 流程去建。

一個 profile 就是一個設定目錄，裡面有兩個 YAML 檔。rodeo-plan.yaml 設定資源與帳密；definition.yaml 描述拓撲：節點、網路、對外服務、開機順序。CLI 讀取這兩個檔案，用 rodeo plan 顯示和主機現況的差異，再用 rodeo deploy 收斂到目標狀態。重複執行是安全的：deploy 預設會把 VM 記憶體與 vCPU 的漂移調回設定值（加 --no-reconcile 可關閉）；需要更大範圍重新套用時，用 --force 或 --from。

docs.title: 主要功能
docs.text: 宣告式 開箱即用 自由調整 為實機打造 安全無虞 Day-2 維運 在哪裡執行 Workshop

docs.title: 先 plan，再套用
docs.text: rodeo plan 會在任何變更發生前，先比對你的 YAML 與主機現況。不會有意外，也不用猜重跑會動到什麼。

docs.title: 12 個內建 profile
docs.text: Harvester HCI（2 節點、3 節點、HA，可搭配或不搭配 Rancher）、SUSE Virtualization workshop、搭配 K3s 與 RKE2 的 Rancher Prime、SUSE Edge、SUSE Telco Cloud、SUSE Multi-Linux Manager，以及單純的 KVM 主機。

docs.title: 自訂 rodeo
docs.text: rodeo new mylab --from harvester 會產生一份可編輯的 profile。修改拓撲後重跑，lab 就會收斂成新的樣子，不必 fork 這個工具。

docs.title: 一個指令就上手
docs.text: rodeo up 會檢查主機、挑一個記憶體放得下的 lab、產生帳密、自動以 sudo 提權，並在 tmux 裡執行，SSH 斷線也不會中斷正在進行的部署。

docs.title: 帳密不進 git
docs.text: 帳密存放在 ~/.rodeo/secrets.yaml（權限 chmod 600），plan 裡用 ??key 占位符引用。任何敏感資料都不需要進到 repo。

docs.title: 不只部署，還能管理
docs.text: rodeo status、rodeo stop/start、rodeo set-password、rodeo install-extensions、rodeo clean：lab 是你可以持續維運的環境，不是跑一次就丟的腳本。

docs.title: 五種部署目標
docs.text: baremetal 與 instruqt 部署在你所在的機器上。aws 與 gcp 從筆電建立機器，再透過 SSH 建好 lab。remote 使用你已經有的 KVM 主機。雲端主機預設 6 小時後終止，除非你設定 provider.ttl_hours。fleet 文件提到 Vultr 與 Hetzner，但尚未實作。請見開始使用。

docs.title: 每位學員一套 lab
docs.text: rodeo fleet 會在多台主機上平行建出同樣的 lab，每套 lab 都能個別查狀態、重試與診斷。 學員可以透過領取入口，用 workshop 代碼領到自己的 lab。請見 Fleet。

docs.title: 一個指令看效果
docs.text:
bash $ curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/avaleror/rodeo-cli/main/install.sh | bash $ rodeo up → checking host resources... → picking a profile that fits (harvester-ha, ~52 GiB) → generating secrets... → deploying... ✓ Lab is up. URLs and credentials printed below.

準備好試試看了嗎？前往開始使用，或直接看 profile 指南。

GPL-3.0 Python 3.10+ KVM / libvirt 底層使用 Ansible

docs.title: 建立自己的 rodeo（宣告式）
docs.text:
rodeo 是用資料描述的，不是用程式碼。你從一個可用的 lab 產生一份 rodeo、編輯兩個 YAML 檔，然後部署它。本指南說明這個流程與檔案格式。

rodeo new mylab --from harvester      # 複製一個可用、可編輯的 lab
$EDITOR ~/.rodeo/profiles/mylab/definition.yaml
rodeo up --profile mylab              # 部署你編輯過的 lab

比較喜歡在瀏覽器裡組合？Rodeo Builder 可以挑選 lab 引擎、 排列故事章節，並下載 profile。

已經有 lab-in-a-box 的 lab（一個 lab.json，或它的 lab-builder 下載的 YAML）？ 一個步驟就能把它變成 rodeo：

rodeo new mylab --from-lab-json lab.json
rodeo up --profile mylab

profile 的 plan 會以 lab_in_a_box.lab 承載這個 lab（請見 plan 參考），rodeo 會照原樣部署它，並套用主機的 網路、網域、節點位址與 secrets。匯入時，帳密值 （password、token、registration code、API key 與 secret key 欄位）會變成 ??<field> 占位符，並列在 operator_secrets 裡，所以 rodeo up 只會詢問一次， plan 裡不會存放任何 secret；在 add-on 設定中直接寫死的節點名稱與位址會 變成 ${node_fqdn:<vm>} / ${node_ip:<vm>}。這個指令會列出這兩者，以及需要 檢查的項目：看起來像這個 lab 的位址卻不屬於任何節點的、Harvester 節點 （rodeo ssh/status 會把它們當成一般 VM），以及透過 PXE 開機的節點（在 lab-in-a-box 安裝好之前連不到）。它也會列出這台機器上的 lab-in-a-box 不認得的欄位，這些欄位 rodeo up 會拒絕。它會對照已安裝的版本來檢查，沒有的話用 RODEO_LABINABOX_PATH，再沒有的話用 rodeo 已下載到 ~/.rodeo/vendor/ 的最新版本。 這些都沒有時，它會告訴你這個 lab 沒有被檢查；不過 rodeo up 在 建置前還是會檢查。

docs.title: 兩個聽起來都像「profile」的詞
docs.text:
名詞 它是什麼 放在哪裡 engine type 部署的 pipeline（會執行哪些階段） plan 裡的 type:；程式碼在 rodeo/profiles/ profile（--profile） 你在 CLI 上挑選、有名稱、可以執行的 lab 一個 config-dir（內建，或放在 ~/.rodeo/profiles/ 下）

目前的 engine type：suse-virt（Harvester HCI + Rancher）、rancher 與 rancher-test（Rancher Prime 加上它建立的 K3s/RKE2 叢集，不含 Harvester），以及 suse-edge（Rancher + Elemental + EIB + edge 節點）。lab-in-a-box 是外部外掛， 有自己的引擎。你的自訂 lab 從中挑一個當作 type，其餘部分自行 自訂。你撰寫的是拓撲，不是新的 pipeline。

列出所有可以部署的項目：

rodeo profiles
Profile 類別 type 內容 rancher-test 內建 rancher-test Rancher Prime + 單節點 K3s 與 RKE2 叢集（最小） rancher 內建 rancher Rancher Prime + 單節點 K3s、單節點 RKE2 與三節點 RKE2 叢集 test 內建 suse-virt 兩節點 Harvester，不含 Rancher harvester-ha 內建 suse-virt 三節點 Harvester，不含 Rancher（etcd HA） harvester-2n 內建 suse-virt 兩節點 Harvester + Rancher Prime harvester 內建 suse-virt 三節點 Harvester HCI + Rancher Prime virt-workshop 內建 suse-virt harvester + 映像快取、NFS 與範例 VM，供 SUSE Virtualization workshop 使用 virt-workshop-2n 內建 suse-virt workshop lab 的兩節點版本 suse-edge 內建 suse-edge Rancher + Elemental + EIB + edge 節點（SUSE Edge 3.7） smlm-workshop 內建 lab-in-a-box SUSE Multi-Linux Manager + 8 台用戶端，由 lab-in-a-box 外掛建置 kvm-hosts 內建 kvm-hosts 一般 KVM 主機，不含 VM；搭配 fleet 就是小型 KVM 叢集（指南） （你的） 自訂 任何 你產生並編輯的任何內容

docs.title: profile 就是一個 config-dir
docs.text:
兩個檔案，加上選用的產出物資料夾：

mylab/
├── rodeo-plan.yaml     # type、資源、帳密、deployment_target
├── definition.yaml     # 拓撲（節點、網路、對外服務、主機準備）
├── certs/              # 選用：要提供的 CA 憑證
├── <hostname>/         # 選用：要在該節點上 kubectl apply 的 manifest（請見下文）
└── custom/scripts/     # 選用：編號的腳本

manifests/ 與 helm/values/ 也會出現在內建範例裡，並記錄在 inventory metadata 中，但目前沒有任何東西會使用它們，它們保留給未來的 階段。不要把檔案放在那裡、期待它們被套用；請使用下一節說明的依主機名稱 命名的目錄。

docs.title: custom/scripts/：在 finalise 之後的 custom_scripts 階段
docs.text:
編號的可執行腳本（50-my-setup.sh、60-seed-vm.sh……）會依排序 順序，在部署的最後一個階段執行，此時叢集與網路都已完全就緒。 每個腳本會拿到：

  • KUBECONFIG：Harvester 的 kubeconfig（如果存在的話，~/.rodeo/harvester-kubeconfig）
  • RODEO_PLAN_NAME、RODEO_LAB_DIR、RODEO_CONFIG_DIR，用來識別執行情境

把它們寫成可重複執行（先檢查再建立）：這個階段和 apply 一樣是 no_cache_phase， 所以每次 rodeo up 都會重新執行，不只是第一次。失敗的腳本會 被明顯地回報，但不會中止其他腳本（它們通常是彼此獨立的步驟）；只要有任何腳本失敗， 這個階段本身最後仍然會被標為失敗，所以 rodeo status／CI 會注意到。 custom_scripts 的防護方式和 finalise 相同：在 deployment_target: instruqt 時會略過，除非加上 --finalise，因為這裡的腳本會建立 持久的叢集狀態，這些狀態應該燒進映像快照，而不是在 每次 session 開機時重新執行。

rodeo up、plan 與 deploy 會自動偵測這個目錄（從目前的 目錄往上層找），所以在 lab 目錄裡可以省略 --config-dir。

docs.title: rodeo-plan.yaml：各項設定
docs.text:
type: suse-virt              # pipeline：suse-virt、rancher、rancher-test 或 suse-edge
name: mylab                  # 用於狀態與 libvirt 物件名稱
deployment_target: baremetal # baremetal | instruqt | aws

resources:
  harvester: { memory_mib: 16384, vcpu: 8, disk_gb: 320 }
  rancher:   { memory_mib: 8192,  vcpu: 4, disk_gb: 60 }

credentials:                 # ??key 會從 ~/.rodeo/secrets.yaml 解析
  harvester_os_password: "??harvester_os_password"
  harvester_admin_password: "??harvester_admin_password"
  rancher_admin_password: "??rancher_admin_password"
  harvester_token: "??harvester_token"

storage:
  device: ""                 # "" = 單一磁碟；在多磁碟主機上可寫 /dev/nvme1n1
  image_dir: /var/lib/libvirt/images

docs.title: definition.yaml：拓撲
docs.text:
這是宣告式模型。你描述邏輯上的 lab；renderer 會把它編譯成 具體的 MAC、DHCP 租約、libvirt 網路、防火牆規則與 PXE 資料。內建的 檔案有大量註解：請把它們當作參考來讀：

  • Harvester：rodeo/data/platforms/suse-virt/definition.yaml
  • Rancher：rodeo/data/platforms/rancher/definition.yaml（它的 downstream_clusters 區塊列出 K3s/RKE2 叢集，以及每個叢集由哪些 VM 加入）
  • SUSE Edge：rodeo/data/platforms/suse-edge/definition.yaml

主要區段：

definition:
  name: mylab
  start_order: [harvester1, harvester2, harvester3, rancher]
  harvester_node_names: [harvester1, harvester2, harvester3]
  harvester_ready_count: 3

  network:
    cidr: 192.168.122.0/24
    gateway: 192.168.122.1
    domain: rodeo.lab

  node_templates:        # 每種節點類型的「藍圖」
    harvester:
      flavor: harvester
      infra_type: harvester     # 讓 stop/start 能依基礎架構處理
      interfaces: [...]         # 網卡的「線路」
    rancher:
      flavor: rancher
      infra_type: rancher

  exposed_services:      # 會變成主機防火牆的 DNAT
    - { name: rancher, host_port: 30002, guest_port: 30002, target: rancher }

  nodes:                 # 具體的 VM
    - name: harvester1
      template: harvester
      ip: 192.168.122.11
      # 省略 mac/uuid/hostname 時會自動產生

你可以省略 MAC、UUID 與主機名稱：renderer 會根據 plan 名稱以確定性的方式 產生它們。只有在需要確切的值時才提供。

docs.title: 把 manifest 套用到節點
docs.text:
把 .yaml/.yml 檔放進以節點主機名稱命名的目錄（和 definition.yaml 中 nodes: 下的某個 name: 相符），例如：

mylab/
└── harvester1/
    └── namespaces.yaml

apply 階段會 SSH 進那個節點，依排序順序對在那裡找到的每個檔案執行 kubectl apply -f -：每個節點一個目錄，只套用到那個節點。 apply 是唯一一個一定會重新執行的階段（它從不快取），所以在這裡編輯檔案 後重新執行 rodeo up --profile mylab，變更會立即生效， 這點和修改拓撲或資源不同（請見下文）。

docs.title: 常見的修改
docs.text:
變更叢集大小（Harvester lab）：一起編輯 nodes、start_order、 harvester_node_names 與 harvester_ready_count，讓它們彼此一致，然後依你的主機 調整 resources。

變更資源：編輯 plan 裡的 resources.harvester / resources.rancher，或 不編輯檔案、在部署時覆寫：

rodeo up --profile mylab            # 或臨時覆寫：
rodeo deploy -P resources.harvester.memory_mib=20480

使用專用磁碟：在 plan 裡設定 storage.device: /dev/nvme1n1（用 lsblk 確認）。

對外提供另一個服務：在 definition 的 exposed_services 加上一筆。

編輯之後，部署之前先預覽：

cd ~/.rodeo/profiles/mylab
rodeo plan

docs.title: 部署之後重新執行
docs.text:
這裡的可重複執行是階段層級，不是資源層級。每個階段（kvm_host、vms、 pxe_server、cluster、rancher、finalise）成功後會在 ~/.rodeo/state/<name>.yaml 標記為完成，單純重新執行時會略過任何已 標記為完成的階段：不論你在 definition.yaml 或 rodeo-plan.yaml 改了什麼。 apply 階段是唯一的例外（它從不快取，所以節點 manifest 的修改一定會在 下次執行時生效：請見把 manifest 套用到節點）。

所以 lab 部署過一次之後，編輯 nodes、resources 或 network 再 重新執行 rodeo up --profile mylab，會略過已完成的階段，只有一個例外： rodeo deploy / rodeo up 預設會調回記憶體／vCPU 的漂移（從 vms 重設）。拓撲變更（新增／移除節點）仍然需要手動處理：

cd ~/.rodeo/profiles/mylab
rodeo plan                  # 一律顯示目前的漂移
rodeo deploy                # 預設會調回記憶體／vCPU 漂移
rodeo deploy --no-reconcile # 舊的僅依階段快取的行為
rodeo deploy --from vms     # 從特定階段接續，或
rodeo deploy --force        # 重做每個階段，或
rodeo clean --yes && rodeo up --profile mylab   # 銷毀這個 lab 的 VM 並重新部署

預設的調整會在實際的記憶體／vCPU 和 plan 不同時，清除快取的 vms（以及之後） 階段狀態。對於正在執行的 domain，libvirt 仍然不會即時調整大小， 請停止／啟動 domain（或 clean + 重新部署），讓非作用中的 XML 生效。

docs.title: 完整流程
docs.text:
rodeo new edge-lab --from harvester     # 以完整的 Harvester lab 為基礎產生
$EDITOR ~/.rodeo/profiles/edge-lab/definition.yaml   # 縮減成 1 個節點，重新調整
rodeo profiles                          # 確認它有列出來（custom）
rodeo up --profile edge-lab             # doctor → secrets → 部署 → 登入資訊

自訂 profile 會從 ~/.rodeo/profiles/<name>/ 就地部署。在 lab 部署過一次之前，編輯檔案後重新執行 rodeo up --profile <name> 就能正常運作， 因為還沒有任何狀態，每個階段都會重新執行。一旦它已經部署過，重新執行只會在 apply 階段讀取檔案的修改；其他階段需要 --force 或 --from（請見 部署之後重新執行），否則會被默默略過。如果 想要從一份新的副本開始、而不是就地編輯，就用新名稱產生，或加上 --dir。

docs.title: 附註
docs.text:
• --from 可以接受任何內建 profile（rodeo profiles 會列出它們）。複製最接近的 可用 lab 再刪減：這是得到有效拓撲風險最低的方式。
  • 帳密維持 ??key 形式；rodeo up/init 會替你產生 ~/.rodeo/secrets.yaml。 不需要 source 或 sudo -E。
  • 部署 Harvester 拓撲會牽動 MAC ↔ DHCP ↔ config-ISO 這條鏈。做了 結構性的修改之後，先在真正的 KVM 主機上驗證，再依賴它。
  • rodeo generate 是較舊的互動式產生器。請優先使用 rodeo new。

docs.title: Fleet：多主機 workshop 編排
docs.text:
在筆電端執行的控制平面，透過 OpenSSH 驅動多台遠端 KVM 主機。 每台主機仍然執行一般的單機 rodeo；fleet 只負責分派與追蹤工作。 Engine 階段、Ansible role 與 nested 網路都沒有改變。

另請參閱：開始使用（單機）、架構、 ROADMAP.md（Phase I）。

docs.title: 各階段功能
docs.text:
階段 狀態 內容 指令 F0 已推出 機器可讀的主機 CLI rodeo doctor --output json, rodeo status --output json F1 已推出 清單 + 唯讀分派 rodeo fleet doctor, rodeo fleet status F2 已推出 部署／重試／存取表 rodeo fleet deploy, retry, access F2.2 已推出 一個指令跑完整個流程 rodeo fleet up F2.1 已推出 失敗鑑識 rodeo fleet diagnose F4a 已推出 AWS 取得主機，每台主機有 6 小時自動銷毀計時（dead-man switch） rodeo fleet provision, deprovision F4b 已推出（單機） GCP rodeo up --target gcp F4c–d 尚未實作 先 Vultr，再 Hetzner。registry 兩者都會拒絕 provider.type 為 vultr 或 hetzner 時會拋出 ConfigError F5 已推出（AWS，v0.18） 學員領取入口（claim portal）：每位學員輸入 workshop 代碼，就能拿到自己的 lab，並透過 player 進入 rodeo fleet open-access, rodeo fleet portal ...（設計、計畫）

主機前置條件（在每台 lab 機器上執行 install.sh 之後）：

rodeo doctor --output json
# 在 lab 目錄中執行：
rodeo status --output json

docs.title: 需要操作者 secret 或其他 UI 的 lab
docs.text:
有些 lab 需要只有你才有的值（lab 的 operator_secrets，例如 SCC regcode 或預先建好的映像網址）。把它們列在 workshop.yaml 裡：fleet deploy 會在 rodeo up 之前，只把這些 key 從你的 ~/.rodeo/secrets.yaml 複製到每台主機（透過 SSH stdin，權限 0600）。只要缺少任何一個，它就會停下來，不會動到任何主機。ui_ports 會在 fleet access 加上欄位：

lab:
  profile: smlm-workshop
  dir: /root/rodeo-lab
  components: []                 # 這個 lab 沒有 Harvester/Rancher UI
  ui_ports: {smlm: 443}
  operator_secrets: [smlm_image_url, smlm_image_sha256, smlm_image_admin_pass,
                     sles15sp5_image_url, sles15sp5_image_sha256,
                     sles15sp6_image_url, sles15sp6_image_sha256]

docs.title: 規劃
docs.text: Fleet 尚未推出的部分。完整檢查清單：ROADMAP Phase I。

docs.title: F4：取得主機
docs.text:
從筆電建立 KVM 主機，合併進 workshop.yaml，然後執行一般的 收斂迴圈。provider 只負責到清單為止；deploy／diagnose／retry 仍然 只走 OpenSSH。

順序 Provider 狀態 F4a AWS（boto3，[aws] extra：請見安裝） MVP 已推出：依 tag 建立／重用、等待 running + SSH、寫入 hosts[]、只終止有 tag 的執行個體 F4b GCP（google-cloud-compute） 單機已實機測試。fleet provision 為每個主機 id 建立一台 VM。領取入口與 open-access 仍只支援 AWS F4c Vultr Bare Metal 尚未實作。get_provider("vultr") 會拒絕 F4d Hetzner Cloud 尚未實作。get_provider("hetzner") 會拒絕

不在範圍內： Equinix Metal（服務已終止）。跨主機共用 secret。 為多主機修改 nested 階段 engine。

MVP 缺口（AWS）： 還沒有 plan dry-run；自動 SG 之後再做。

本機清理。 deprovision 也會移除筆電為每台被終止的 主機保留的東西：workshop.yaml 中它的 hosts[] 項目、 ~/.rodeo/fleet/<workshop>/known_hosts 中它的 host key，以及它的學員 SSH key。當主機都沒了 而且 portal 也已移除時，~/.rodeo/fleet/<workshop>/ 與 workshop.job.yaml 也會一併刪除。BYO 主機、終止失敗的主機、workshop.yaml 的其他內容、plan、secrets.yaml 以及受管理的 SSH key 都不會被動到。--json 會在 local_cleanup 底下列出移除了哪些東西。

pip install -e '.[aws]'        # 只需一次，在你的 rodeo-cli checkout 中執行（請見 install.md）
# AWS API 帳密（boto3：絕不放進 YAML）。二擇一：
#   ~/.aws/credentials  （+ 可選的 AWS_PROFILE / ~/.aws/config）
#   或 AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID + AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY（+ 可選的 AWS_SESSION_TOKEN）
# SSH：每個 workshop 都有自己的 key（~/.rodeo/ssh/labs/<workshop>/），會隨 workshop 一起刪除
rodeo fleet provision -f workshop.yaml    # 建立／重用 → 寫入 hosts[]
rodeo fleet deploy -f workshop.yaml       # 在每台主機安裝 rodeo，啟動 lab
rodeo fleet doctor -f workshop.yaml       # 主機上需要有 rodeo，所以要在 deploy 之後
rodeo fleet deprovision -f workshop.yaml --yes

共用的 HostProvider Protocol 與 provider: YAML schema： 請見下方的取得主機設計。

docs.title: 相關功能（不限 Fleet）
docs.text:
單機的 deployment_target: aws 與 fleet 建立主機共用同一個 rodeo/providers/aws adapter 與 provider: YAML schema。 在 EC2 guest 上，lab 仍然以 baremetal 執行。

實機冒煙測試檢查清單：

  • AWS 單機 + fleet
  • 測試：AWS 實機冒煙測試

docs.title: F0：單機上的 JSON
docs.text:
結構化報告放在 rodeo/service/，讓 CLI 與 fleet 共用同一種格式。

rodeo doctor --output json
rodeo status --output json   # 需要有 lab（目前目錄或 --config-dir）

預設的 --output text 保留原本的 Rich 表格。

docs.title: 清單（workshop.yaml）
docs.text:
name: suse-virt-rodeo-emea
lab:
  dir: /root/suse-virt-workshop     # 遠端路徑（status + deploy 的工作目錄）
  # F2：以下二擇一：
  source: git:https://github.com/avaleror/suse-virt-workshop.git
  # profile: harvester              # 另一種做法：植入內建／自訂 profile
  branch: main                      # 可選（僅限 git）
  target: baremetal                 # baremetal | instruqt（AWS 主機請用 baremetal）
  concurrency: 4                    # deploy/retry 預設的 -j
  ports:
    harvester: 8443                 # 在主機 public IP 上做 DNAT
    rancher: 30002
  # components: [harvester]         # 可選：請見下方的「存取表」。
  #                                  # 省略的話，會顯示 fleet 能組出的所有網址。
  # ref: main                        # 主機要執行的 rodeo-cli git ref
  # install_url: https://…           # install.sh 的 fork 或離線鏡像站
defaults:
  ssh_user: ec2-user                 # AMI 使用者（ec2-user / sles / root）；非 root 時透過 sudo -n 執行
  # identity_file: 可選；預設為 workshop key（雲端）或 ~/.rodeo/ssh/id_ed25519
hosts:
  - id: student-01
    ssh: 203.0.113.11               # host 或 user@host
    public_ip: 203.0.113.11         # 供 fleet access 使用
    labels: { room: a }
  - id: student-02
    ssh: root@lab-02.example
    public_ip: 203.0.113.12
    labels: { room: b }

驗證採 fail-closed：id 不可重複、ssh 必填、lab.dir 必填。 lab.source 或 lab.profile 只有在 deploy／retry 時才是必填。

docs.title: F1：doctor 與 status
docs.text:
rodeo fleet doctor -f workshop.yaml
rodeo fleet status -f workshop.yaml --output json

rodeo fleet doctor -f workshop.yaml --label room=a
rodeo fleet status -f workshop.yaml --host student-01 -j 4
  • 只有在每台選定的主機都成功時，結束碼才是 0。
  • 兩者都會在主機上執行 rodeo，所以在裝好之前都會以 rodeo: command not found 失敗。 對於由 rodeo fleet provision 建立的主機，安裝是在 rodeo fleet deploy 中進行，所以要在 deploy 之後才跑 doctor。對於已經執行過 install.sh 的 BYO 主機，doctor 在 deploy 之前也能用。
  • doctor： 只看遠端程序的結束碼還不夠，fleet 也會檢查 KVM、nested virt、核心工具，以及內建 profile 是否放得進 RAM （rodeo/fleet/doctor.py::_readiness_problems）。
  • status： 在每台主機的 lab.dir 中執行。如果有 workshop.job.yaml， status 會更新每台主機的工作狀態，供之後重試使用。

docs.title: 大型活動之前：rodeo fleet preflight
docs.text:
在建立任何資源之前，執行唯讀檢查：

rodeo fleet preflight -f workshop.yaml              # 依清單的規劃
rodeo fleet preflight -f workshop.yaml --count 30   # 用同一個檔案規劃更大的活動
  • vCPU 配額：該執行個體系列的隨需配額中可用的 vCPU，與新主機（以及 portal 機器） 所需的數量比較。超過 80% 時警告，超過配額時失敗，並列出要提高的 Service Quotas 代碼。 請在活動前數週向 AWS 申請：提高配額不會立即生效。
  • 執行個體類型：子網路所在的可用區域有提供此類型。
  • AWS 工作階段：可自動更新的憑證（aws login、SSO）沒有問題；固定憑證的有效時間 必須超過約一小時的執行。
  • 有 player: 區塊時：Route 53 區域存在，且活動憑證還有 7 天以上的效期 （fleet cert 會簽發或更新）。

有檢查失敗時，結束代碼為 1。

docs.title: 從雲端執行：rodeo fleet operator
docs.text:
長時間的 fleet up 不應該依賴筆電：闔上螢幕、睡眠或 Wi-Fi 斷線都會讓它停止。operator 主機是 workshop 子網路中的一台小型執行個體（t3.small），替你執行 fleet 指令：

rodeo fleet operator up    -f workshop.yaml   # 建立主機，安裝 rodeo 與 AWS CLI
rodeo fleet operator login -f workshop.yaml   # 在主機上執行 aws login --remote
rodeo fleet operator push  -f workshop.yaml   # workshop 目錄、lab 金鑰、known_hosts、活動憑證
rodeo fleet operator run   -f workshop.yaml -- up --track-ref <sha> --images-bucket <bucket>
rodeo fleet operator logs  -f workshop.yaml   # Ctrl-C 只停止追蹤，不會停止執行
rodeo fleet operator status -f workshop.yaml  # running、done 或 failed (exit N)
rodeo fleet operator pull  -f workshop.yaml   # 取回結果；會先備份本機副本
rodeo fleet operator down  -f workshop.yaml
  • AWS 工作階段：login 會在主機上執行 aws login --remote。在任何裝置上開啟網址， 再把代碼貼回來。只要主控台工作階段仍有效，CLI 會自動更新，所以筆電可以睡眠。 執行個體角色不需要登入也能做到，但建立角色需要 PowerUser 沒有的 IAM 權限。
  • 安全性：主機上有 lab SSH 金鑰、活動憑證與一個 AWS 工作階段。它的安全群組只對你的 筆電 IP 開放 SSH，與每台 rodeo 執行個體一樣有 dead-man switch，down 會移除它。
  • 兩邊都能 SSH 到 lab：從 operator 主機執行時，lab 的 SSH 仍允許你的筆電 IP， 與 operator 自己的 IP 並存。
  • 不影響學員：學員和以前一樣，透過 open-access 從任何網路連到 lab。
  • run 接的 fleet 指令不用加 -f。主機上沒有人能回答提示，指令需要確認時請加上 --yes。

docs.title: 一個指令：rodeo fleet up
docs.text:
rodeo fleet up 會依序執行下方整套講師流程：provision、 deploy、portal up、等到每個 lab 都完成、open-access、 portal publish 與 portal info（沒有 portal 時則是 access）。

# 新的 workshop：寫入 workshop.yaml，然後部署
rodeo fleet up --profile virt-workshop --count 3 \
  --guide-url https://avaleror.github.io/suse-virt-workshop/

# 既有的清單，或接續一次中斷的執行
rodeo fleet up -f workshop.yaml

加上 --profile 與 --count 時，它會寫入 -f（預設為 workshop.yaml，這個檔案 必須還不存在）：AWS 位於 --region（預設為 RODEO_AWS_REGION，否則為 eu-north-1）、使用 profile 的 --instance-tier（預設 recommended），除非 指定了 --instance-type、使用該 region 預設 VPC 的 public subnet，除非指定了 --subnet-id、--ttl-hours（預設 6），以及領取入口，除非加上 --no-portal。之後每一個 rodeo fleet 指令都使用同一個檔案。

它最多等待 --wait-minutes（預設 90），遇到第一個失敗的 lab 就停下來， 並列出要執行的 diagnose／retry --failed-only 指令。再次執行 rodeo fleet up -f workshop.yaml 就會接續：主機會被重用，已完成的 lab 會被略過。用 rodeo fleet deprovision -f workshop.yaml --yes 拆除。

docs.title: 講師流程
docs.text:
rodeo fleet deploy -f workshop.yaml -j 4
rodeo fleet doctor -f workshop.yaml -j 8     # 在 deploy 之後：主機上需要有 rodeo
rodeo fleet status -f workshop.yaml          # 反覆查詢，直到各階段完成
rodeo fleet diagnose -f workshop.yaml        # 抓取失敗主機的 log
rodeo fleet retry -f workshop.yaml --failed-only
rodeo fleet access -f workshop.yaml --output json

docs.title: fleet deploy 在每台主機上做了什麼
docs.text:
1. 確保 rodeo 在 PATH 上（缺少時執行 install.sh，指定 ref 時則每次都執行； 請見主機執行哪一版 rodeo-cli）。
  2. 同步 lab：git clone／git pull --ff-only，若是 profile 則執行 rodeo up --no-deploy。
  3. 啟動背景執行（detached）的 tmux，在 lab.dir 中執行 rodeo up --yes --no-tmux （session 名稱為 rodeo-fleet-<workshop>-<host-id>）。
  4. 立即返回：不會等待 90–150 分鐘的安裝。
  5. 在清單旁邊寫入 workshop.job.yaml（chmod 600）。

可快取的階段已經全部 completed 的主機會被略過， 除非加上 --force。apply 階段永遠不會被快取（每次本機部署都會重跑）， 也不會擋住這項檢查。

secret：由遠端 rodeo up 為每台主機各自產生，fleet 絕不會 scp 一份共用的 secrets.yaml。

docs.title: 工作檔
docs.text:
workshop: suse-virt-rodeo-emea
hosts:
  student-01:
    state: running    # pending | running | ok | failed
    tmux: rodeo-fleet-suse-virt-rodeo-emea-student-01
  student-02:
    state: failed
    last_error: "..."

docs.title: 重試
docs.text:
rodeo fleet retry -f workshop.yaml --failed-only   # 預設
rodeo fleet retry -f workshop.yaml --all-selected  # 忽略工作失敗紀錄；搭配 --host/--label 使用

先從即時的 status 更新工作狀態，再對選定的主機以 --force 重新啟動部署。

docs.title: 主機執行哪一版 rodeo-cli
docs.text:
主機會從 GitHub 自行安裝：你本機的工作目錄永遠不會傳到 主機上。預設情況下，安裝只在缺少 rodeo 的主機上執行，所以主機 會一直保留第一次安裝時的程式碼；--force 重跑的是部署，不是 安裝。

對於鎖定在某個 release 的 workshop，這樣沒問題；但如果你剛 push 了一個修正，就不對了：整個 fleet 的部署會悄悄地在每台主機上同時跑舊的程式碼。 指定一個 ref 來強制更新：

rodeo fleet deploy -f workshop.yaml --ref main         # 每台主機都用 main 的最新版
rodeo fleet retry  -f workshop.yaml --ref feat/my-fix  # 用修正版重跑失敗的主機

指定 ref 時，安裝每次都會執行，install.sh --ref 會把每台 主機的 checkout 強制重設（hard reset）到那個 ref。lab.ref 在清單中設定同樣的東西；--ref 會覆寫它。安裝程式會從它要 checkout 的同一個 ref 抓取，除非 lab.install_url 明確指向別處（fork、離線鏡像站），這時會 原樣使用該網址，並把 ref 傳給它。無效的 ref 會在載入清單時就失敗，在連到任何主機之前。

這和單機的 rodeo up --target aws --ref … 是同一套機制，兩條 路徑共用 rodeo/install_source.py。

docs.title: Diagnose（失敗鑑識）
docs.text:
fleet status／工作檔會告訴你是哪一台主機、哪個階段失敗。要知道 原因，把 log 抓回筆電：

rodeo fleet diagnose -f workshop.yaml                  # 失敗的主機（預設）
rodeo fleet diagnose -f workshop.yaml --all-selected   # 每台選定的主機
rodeo fleet diagnose -f workshop.yaml -o /tmp/diag --output json

每台主機的結果放在 <inventory>.diagnose-<utc>/<host-id>/（或 -o 指定的位置）下：

產出物 來源 status.json 遠端 rodeo status --output json logs/*.log ~/.rodeo/logs/ 的結尾部分（包含 fleet-up.log） meta/state/ ~/.rodeo/state/*.yaml 階段快取 meta/tmux-pane.txt 工作 session 還在時擷取的 tmux pane 內容 summary.json 該主機的簡短失敗摘要 index.json 整個 workshop 的索引（使用 --output json 時也會印出）

不會印出或收集 secret。收集成功時結束碼為 0；任何主機的 SSH 或封存解壓縮失敗時為 1。

docs.title: 存取表
docs.text:
rodeo fleet access -f workshop.yaml
id Harvester Rancher student-01 https://203.0.113.11:8443 https://203.0.113.11:30002

Nested VIP 在每台主機內部維持 192.168.122.10；學員使用主機 public IP + DNAT。密碼絕不會印出：它們存放在每台主機的 ~/.rodeo/secrets.yaml。

預設情況下，access 會為每台主機印出兩個網址，因為 fleet 在本機沒有可靠的 訊號判斷某個 lab 實際提供哪些 UI（內建 profile 名稱不會一對一對應到元件：例如 test profile 的範例目錄 完全沒有 Rancher 節點）。在清單中設定 lab.components: [harvester] 或 [rancher]，就能隱藏不適用於你的 workshop 的網址。

存取表是給講師用的。若要讓每位學員拿到自己的 lab（連結、 帳密，而且從任何網路都連得到），請使用 領取入口。

docs.title: 學員網路存取（AWS）
docs.text:
rodeo 管理的 security group 只允許操作者的 IP，所以預設情況下學員 連不到自己的 lab。若要讓他們從任何網路進來、又不用知道他們的 IP，請設定 provider.student_access: open，並在每個 lab 都起來之後開放 lab UI 的 port：

provider:
  type: aws
  student_access: open     # operator（預設） | open

rodeo fleet provision -f workshop.yaml     # port 維持只對操作者開放
rodeo fleet deploy -f workshop.yaml
rodeo fleet status -f workshop.yaml        # 等到每台主機都完成
rodeo fleet open-access -f workshop.yaml   # 8443/30002 對 0.0.0.0/0 開放
rodeo fleet open-access --close -f workshop.yaml

除非每台主機都已完成所有階段，而且 Harvester 與 Rancher 管理者密碼都夠強（16 個字元以上，包含大寫、小寫與數字），否則 open-access 會拒絕執行。 檢查在每台主機上進行，只回報 strong／weak／missing；密碼絕不會 離開主機。security group 由整個 workshop 共用，所以只要有一台主機 還沒準備好，就會擋住所有主機的開放。port 依照 lab.components 決定；SSH（22）一律 只對操作者開放。之後任何一次 fleet provision 都會再把 port 關起來。若使用 provider.security_group_ids（BYO），rodeo 不會做任何變更，而是請你自己開放 這些 port。

docs.title: 共用帳號：哪些資源是誰的（AWS 與 GCP）
docs.text:
常常有好幾個人部署到同一個 AWS 帳號，而且 lab 名稱會重複：兩個人都跑 rancher-test profile，就會各有一個叫 rancher-test 的 lab。所以 rodeo 絕不只憑 lab 名稱挑選雲端資源。每個資源都帶有 rodeo-owner（呼叫者的 ARN，CI 中則是 RODEO_OWNER）與 rodeo-deployment （8 個十六進位字元，由 lab key 產生），由這兩者決定哪些是你的。

  • 兩個人可以在同一個 region、同一時間使用相同的 plan 或 workshop 名稱。 每個人都有自己的執行個體、security group （rodeo-<lab>-<deployment>）與 key pair。
  • rodeo destroy --cloud、fleet deprovision 與 portal 拆除只會移除 這個登入身分擁有的部署。這台機器上沒有 lab key 時，只會處理 這台機器記錄過的執行個體 id；一個都沒有就拒絕執行。
  • rodeo cloud ls 列出你在某個 region 的部署（--all 會列出所有人的， 並顯示擁有者）。它從 AWS 讀取 tag，所以換一台筆電也能用。
  • rodeo cloud destroy <deployment> 可以在任何地方移除你的某個部署： 執行個體、security group 與 key pair。要移除別人的部署需要 --not-mine，而且你必須輸入對方的擁有者名稱確認。
  • 這項改變之前建立的 lab 沒有 rodeo-deployment。持有它們 key 的機器 會在下一次 up 或 destroy 時接管它們（補上 tag，名稱不變）。 其他人在 rodeo cloud ls --all 中會看到它們標示為 legacy。

GCP 上規則相同，但有三點不同。擁有者是你的 GCP 帳號 （來自 Application Default Credentials）。label 不能包含 @ 或 .，所以 rodeo-owner label 是一個易讀的形式加上一段短雜湊，原始帳號則放在 執行個體的 metadata 中。防火牆規則不能加 label，所以 rodeo-<lab>-<deployment> 會把擁有者與部署記錄在說明欄位中。請使用 rodeo cloud ls --provider gcp （整個 project）與 rodeo cloud destroy --provider gcp <deployment>。這項改變之前的 GCP lab，由 lab 公鑰位於執行個體 ssh-keys metadata 中的那台機器接管。

擁有者檢查是為了防止 rodeo 指令動到錯的 lab。它不是權限系統： 任何有 PowerUser 權限的人仍然可以在主控台刪除執行個體。

docs.title: 追蹤 workshop 費用
docs.text:
上面這些 tag 也是成本分配 tag（cost allocation tag）。rodeo-workshop 依 workshop 拆分帳單，rodeo-owner 依人拆分，ManagedBy 則加總 rodeo 執行的所有資源。

  • 要在 AWS 的管理（付款）帳號中啟用，位置在 Billing 的 Cost allocation tags。連結帳號（linked account）無法啟用（在那裡 aws ce list-cost-allocation-tags 會失敗），請詢問負責帳務的人。
  • 啟用後約 24 小時才會出現新資料。回填（最多回溯 12 個月， 每 24 小時只能申請一次）只會計入資源上已經有該 tag 的時數。
  • 值有區分大小寫：rodeo-workshop=suse-virt 與 SUSE-Virt 在帳單上是 兩行。
  • 根磁碟區與網路介面也帶有這些 tag，所以磁碟費用會算在該 workshop 下。公開 IPv4 的費用在 Cost Explorer 中是否會跟著網路介面的 tag， 目前尚未確認：依賴它之前請先看一次實際帳單。

tag 只能說明帳單，不能限制金額。上限仍然是自動銷毀計時：預設 6 小時， 最多 168 小時（provider.ttl_hours）。

docs.title: 領取入口（F5）
docs.text:
學員開啟一個 HTTPS 頁面，輸入你給他們的 workshop 代碼（來自 portal info，例如 RODEO-XVFD-20260930；大小寫、空格與連字號都不影響）。 輸入之後才會看到 lab 看板與領取表單：姓名、email，以及自己選的 6 位數 PIN（123456 或 111111 這類太明顯的會被拒絕）。他們會拿到 自己的 lab：Harvester 與 Rancher 網址加上管理者密碼，也可以選擇提供 lab 主機的 SSH key。你可以看到誰拿了哪個 lab。設計： claim-portal.md。

回到 lab 的方式：

  1. 同一台裝置： 瀏覽器會記住這個 lab 3 天；重新開啟 portal 會顯示「Continue to your lab」，甚至在輸入 workshop 代碼之前就會出現。「Not you? Forget this device」可以在共用電腦上清除紀錄。
  2. 另一台裝置： 「Already have a lab? Get it back」只要求輸入 email 與 PIN （email 用來找到 lab，PIN 證明這是他們的，所以兩位學員用同一個 PIN 也沒關係）。它會用新的連結回傳同一個 lab；舊的連結會 失效。領取關閉期間也能使用。PIN 錯五次會鎖住該 email。
  3. 其他情況： 講師頁面上有每一個 lab，而 rodeo fleet portal unlock EMAIL 可以解除鎖定。

隱私：每個頁面都有一行頁尾（「we only keep your name and email for this workshop, deleted when it ends; essential cookies only」），連結到 /privacy， 領取表單在輸入資料的地方也會重複這段說明。/privacy（公開，不需要代碼） 說明保留了什麼、保留多久，以及三個 cookie（csrf、access、lab）； 其中的期限來自設定 cookie 的同一組常數，若兩者不一致，測試就會失敗。 在公開活動之前，請先讓你的隱私團隊審閱這些措辭。

provider:
  type: aws
  student_access: open        # 必填：學員必須連得到自己的 lab
portal:
  enabled: true
  mode: open                  # open（workshop 代碼 + email） | roster（邀請連結） | both
  # roster: students.csv      # roster / both：CSV，欄位為 name,email[,host_id]
  title: SUSE Virtualization workshop
  guide_url: https://avaleror.github.io/suse-virt-workshop/   # 或 /guide/，若由 portal 提供
  # code_letters: 6           # RODEO-XXXXXX-YYYYMMDD 中的隨機字母數（4-8；6 = 1.91 億組代碼）
  # hostname: labs.example.com   # 預設為 portal-<ip>.sslip.io（Let's Encrypt）
  # instance_type: t3.small

rodeo fleet provision -f workshop.yaml     # lab + 一台小型 portal VM（獨立 SG：443/80 開放，22 限操作者）
rodeo fleet portal up -f workshop.yaml     # portal 服務 + 使用正式 TLS 憑證的 Caddy
rodeo fleet deploy -f workshop.yaml
rodeo fleet player-setup -f workshop.yaml  # 學生 UI（見 docs/player.md）；fleet up 會自動完成這些步驟
rodeo fleet open-access -f workshop.yaml   # 等每個 lab 都完成後執行：有 player 時只開放 443
rodeo fleet portal publish --watch -f workshop.yaml  # 在講師頁面上追蹤部署進度；
                                           # 每個 lab 一準備好就會發布
rodeo fleet portal info -f workshop.yaml   # 放在投影片上的網址 + workshop 代碼
rodeo fleet portal status -f workshop.yaml # 誰拿了哪個 lab
rodeo fleet portal admin-link -f workshop.yaml  # 講師頁面（包含所有 lab 帳密；不要投影出來）
rodeo fleet deprovision --yes -f workshop.yaml  # lab + portal（加 --keep-portal 保留 portal）

為沒到場的人縮減規模。 依預期人數建立主機，等 現場人數穩定之後，再移除沒人領取的 lab：

rodeo fleet portal status -f workshop.yaml                  # 還有幾個空的？
rodeo fleet deprovision --yes -f workshop.yaml --unclaimed 35   # 保留幾個備用
rodeo fleet deprovision --yes -f workshop.yaml --unclaimed all  # 或移除所有未領取的 lab

--unclaimed N 會自己挑選 lab：先挑還沒準備好的（仍在建置或 失敗的），再從編號最大的空閒 lab 往下挑，所以留下來的備用 lab 是 編號小的，也就是新的領取會優先拿到的那些。如果數字大於 portal 上未領取的 lab 數，它會拒絕執行。若要手動挑選 lab，改用 --host <lab> （可重複指定）；學員已領取的 lab 會被拒絕，除非你加上 --force。

不論哪種方式，在移除 lab 的期間都會暫停領取，之後再重新開放（如果 原本是開放的），而被終止的 lab 也會從 portal 移除，所以沒有人會 領到已經不存在的 lab。portal VM 本身永遠不會被動到。在 roster 模式下，每位 受邀的學員都算已領取，不論有沒有開啟過。在這個 release 之前建立的 portal 需要執行一次 rodeo fleet portal up，才會學到移除指令；在那之前， deprovision 會發出警告並讓領取維持關閉。

講師指令 內容 portal publish [--watch] [--interval 60] 把 lab 推送到 portal。加上 --watch 時：講師頁面上會顯示每個 lab 的部署進度（已完成階段、目前階段、經過時間、失敗），每個 lab 一準備好就能被領取。請讓筆電保持喚醒（install.md） portal status / export [-o file.csv] 領取紀錄：lab、姓名、email、領取方式、領取時間、第一次開啟時間 portal admin-link 產生講師頁面的新秘密連結：包含每一筆領取紀錄，以及每個 lab 的網址、密碼與 SSH key（舊的連結會失效） portal open / close / rotate-code 領取時段；產生新的 workshop 代碼（會讓所有人登出看板；個人 lab 連結仍可使用） portal release LAB / revoke EMAIL / reassign EMAIL LAB / unlock EMAIL 在 workshop 進行中修正錯誤 portal invite [--rotate] Roster 模式：保留 lab，寫出包含個人連結的 <workshop>-invites.csv（0600）

各項防護機制：

  • portal 是被動的。 它永遠不會連到 lab 主機或雲端 API，也不持有 rodeo SSH key 或雲端帳密。是由筆電透過 SSH、經由 stdin 把 lab 紀錄推送給它。 portal 的程式碼是 rodeo/portal/（只用標準函式庫），原樣複製過去， 並以非特權使用者在強化過的 systemd unit 中執行。
  • 先輸入 workshop 代碼。 portal 的主機名稱幾分鐘內就會公開（TLS 憑證會記錄在 Certificate Transparency 中），所以在輸入代碼之前，首頁 只會顯示一個代碼欄位。輸入之後，一個 cookie（綁定 目前的代碼，24 小時）會顯示所有 lab 的看板（空閒／已領取／建置中）， 上面只有領取者的姓名，絕不顯示 email 或任何帳密，還有領取 表單。預設代碼有 6 個隨機字母（約 1.91 億組代碼）。錯誤的代碼 也會在所有位址合計後設上限（每 10 分鐘 200 次），所以即使 1,000 個 位址同時嘗試，在 8 小時的 workshop 中猜中的機率也只有約 0.06%。設定 portal.code_letters（4-8）可以改變長度，若 代碼外洩則用 rotate-code。升級之後，對既有 portal 執行的下一次 portal up 會把它的 代碼換成新的長度（設定 code_letters: 4 可保留舊的代碼）。
  • Workshop 指南連結： 設定 portal.guide_url 後，每個學員頁面（領取頁面，以及 他們的 lab 頁面中帳密上方）都會連結到練習題：可以是 https:// 網址，例如 GitHub Pages，或是由 portal 本身提供的路徑。指南預設放在 GitHub Pages， 因為 portal 會隨 fleet 一起銷毀，而學員在 workshop 結束後仍可保留指南。 隨時可以用 portal up 更改；領取紀錄會保留。
  • 講師頁面放在秘密連結後面，會顯示 email、部署進度以及 每個 lab 的帳密。
  • 領取： 個人連結是 24 個隨機位元組，以 SHA-256 儲存，PIN 以 scrypt 儲存， PIN 錯 5 次會鎖住該 email，每個表單都有 CSRF 防護，並設有 no-store 與 CSP 標頭。只有 失敗的嘗試（錯誤的代碼或 PIN、未知的連結）會計入每個位址每 10 分鐘 30 次的 上限，所以整間教室共用一個 NAT 位址也能領取。 錯誤的 workshop 代碼也會計入整個 portal 每 10 分鐘 200 次的上限。 超過之後，只有已經送出 3 次錯誤代碼的位址需要等待；新學員仍然 可以進入，已經進入的人也會保有 24 小時的存取權。 log 中絕不會包含 token、email、代碼、PIN 或密碼。
  • 學員 SSH： 每台 lab 主機一個 student 使用者，僅限 key 登入，key 是在 你的筆電上另外產生的（~/.rodeo/fleet/<workshop>/student-keys/）。Publish 會在每台 主機上驗證該使用者沒有 sudo、不屬於任何特權群組，而且無法讀取 /root （整個 fleet 共用的 rodeo key 就放在那裡）；任何一項檢查失敗都會中止。學員永遠拿不到 lab 主機的 root。
  • publish 可以安全地重跑（在 fleet retry 之後，或某個 lab 較晚完成時）： 還沒準備好的 lab 會對學員顯示為「still building」，而且絕不會被 分配出去。

docs.title: OpenSSH 需求
docs.text:
• 使用 BatchMode=yes 的 key 驗證（不會出現密碼提示）。
  • Host key 在第一次使用時信任，之後依 workshop 固定下來 （StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new、~/.rodeo/fleet/<workshop>/known_hosts），因為 fleet 會透過這些連線傳送 lab 密碼與學員 key。建立主機時 會忘掉它建立的每個位址的 key（EC2 會重複使用 public IP）。如果某台主機 在 rodeo 之外被重建，而 SSH 回報 host key 已變更，請用 ssh-keygen -R <ip> -f ~/.rodeo/fleet/<workshop>/known_hosts 移除。lab 內部的 主機→VM 連線（rodeo/ssh.py）仍然略過驗證：那些 VM 一直在 私有網路上被重建。
  • 筆電的 PATH 上要有 ssh；Agent／ProxyJump／identity_file 照常可用。
  • 每台遠端主機上：SSH 使用者的 PATH 上要有 rodeo + tmux；通常是 root@。

Fleet 不會在筆電上以 sudo 重新執行自己。

docs.title: 設計備註
docs.text:
• rodeo/ssh.py = 主機→VM 的 lab 連線。
  • rodeo/fleet/ssh_exec.py = 筆電→KVM 主機。
  • 並行數預設值：doctor/status 為 -j 8；deploy/retry 使用 lab.concurrency （預設 4），除非指定了 -j。deploy 建議使用低並行數（ISO／網路）。
  • F4 取得主機請見規劃。Equinix 不在範圍內。 共用 secret 與修改階段 pipeline 仍然不屬於 Fleet。

docs.title: F4 取得主機設計
docs.text:
取得主機的共用 Protocol／schema。AWS（F4a）MVP 已實作於 rodeo/providers/，供 Fleet 與單機 deployment_target: aws 使用。 Vultr／Hetzner 仍是 stub；GCP 已有 provider（單機已實機測試）。摘要請見規劃。

重要：絕不要在 workshop.yaml 中設定 lab.target: aws。

由 AWS 建立的 workshop 主機以 lab.target: baremetal 執行 lab（完整的 firewalld／DNAT／finalise）。deployment_target: aws 是筆電 控制平面／plan 的主機情境標記（rodeo up --target aws，以及 保留在執行個體上、用於磁碟下限 + destroy --cloud 的 plan）。把 lab.target: aws 混進 Fleet 清單會破壞階段的行為。

面向 單機 Fleet workshop 取得主機 rodeo up --target aws + plan 中的 provider: rodeo fleet provision + workshop.yaml 中的 provider: Lab 拓撲 profile --profile harvester 在每台主機上植入相同的基礎 profile 在 KVM 主機上執行 以 baremetal 執行各階段 lab.target: baremetal 主機上的 plan 標記 保留 deployment_target: aws 不要設定 lab.target: aws

docs.title: HostProvider Protocol
docs.text:
位於規劃中的 rodeo/providers/ 的共用合約。Fleet CLI 絕不直接 import boto3/GCP/hcloud： 只透過 registry + 這組介面。

型別（概念上）

名稱 角色 ProviderConfig 解析後的 workshop.yaml → provider: 對應（type + 各 type 專屬欄位） ProvisionSpec Workshop 名稱、想要的數量／host id、SSH 預設值、要套用的 label ProvisionedHost 一對一對應到清單的 hosts[]：id、ssh、public_ip、labels、可選的 provider_id（雲端執行個體 id） DeprovisionResult 每台主機的結果：destroyed／skipped／error

必要操作

方法 行為 name 固定 id：aws | gcp | vultr | hetzner validate(config) → None 欄位缺少或無效時 fail closed（ConfigError），只檢查該 type 的欄位 plan(spec, config) → list[action] 可選的 dry-run：對每個想要的 host id 回報 create／reuse／noop（F4a 有的話更好） provision(spec, config) → list[ProvisionedHost] 冪等：重用已為此 workshop+host id 加上 tag 的執行個體；其餘的則建立；等到 running + SSH BatchMode 成功 deprovision(spec, config) → list[DeprovisionResult] 只銷毀帶有下方擁有權 tag 的資源；拒絕沒有 tag 的資源

共用部分（非各 provider 各自實作）

  • SSH 等待／探測使用既有的 rodeo/fleet/ssh_exec.py（不用 paramiko）。
  • 清單合併：依 id 寫入／更新 hosts[]；除非加上 --prune，否則不刪除靜態主機。
  • 可選 extra：[aws]、[gcp]、[vultr]、[hetzner]，讓核心安裝保持輕量。

擁有權 tag（每個建立的執行個體都有；所有雲端使用相同的 key）
